record.reason: DA-VAE expands a pretrained diffusion VAE latent while preserving detail structure, enabling high-resolution image generation with fewer tokens; experiments report up to 6x speedup for SD3.5 generation. It is diffusion image generation, not LLM inference; the PyTorch compile lineage is incidental.
record.title: DA-VAE: Plug-in Latent Compression for Diffusion via Detail Alignment
